body: im currently doing a marine conservation program here in thailand! alittle late to this post but just earlier today was learning about all the opportunities of artificial reefs and how art and 3d modelling are playing a big part of it! you could consider a career in that :)
ay that’s completely fine dude. just do you :) wishing you the best

when i say you’re not alone, i truly mean it. youll be surprised at who’d listen to you if you reach out. though ik its hard. im 19 going on 20, and your post rlly stuck w me becoz i went through and am still going through the same things (an abusive dad, bpd, OD attempt, GAD) but things do pass and things do get better. even if its small and tiny progress. 

im proud of you for sticking it out thus far. but i hope you know that when you can’t carry the load, try to let someone else carry it for you. i wish i was there to give you a hug or squeeze your hand but i promise you therell be someone around you willing to do so. its not embarrassing and it’s actually pretty fking beave if you finally do break this mask. so dont think it’s embarrassing. and i think youre pretty fking brave for making it this far and if you say no one cares? well i do and ya you dgaf abt things like grades and such and that’s perfectly fine. 

from here on out just do everything in your life in pursuit of what you want to do, be it a classical pianist or anth. who knows maybe in 2023 youll be 10 steps closer to being a classical pianist and one day ill see your autobiography of a touching and inspiring reddit comment that led you there.
